examples.description: Recent Brønnøysund changes for one org since a date

description: Read Apier's cross-source change archive — detected created / updated / deleted events across the upstreams Apier polls (Brønnøysund ingestion plus the Altinn-schema, DigDir-policy, and Norges Bank pollers) so agents drive incremental sync instead of re-fetching whole entities. `observation_kind` separates cache warm-up rows from genuine transitions. Filter by { source, entity_type, entity_id, change_type } and a { from }–{ to } detected_at range. Queries WITHOUT entity_id withhold personal-field rows by design (`personal_fields_withheld: true`); the org-scoped form returns everything. Keyset-paginated newest-first: pass { limit } (1–500, default 50) and carry `next_cursor` back verbatim — cursors are HMAC-signed; an edited one is rejected as CURSOR_INVALID - start over without a cursor. Failure modes: VALIDATION_FAILED, CURSOR_INVALID; a credential without `read:changes` can't see the tool; a call returns unknown tool (-32602). No sandbox mirror — a sandbox bearer gets SANDBOX_TOOL_UNAVAILABLE. Docs: https://www.apier.no/docs/guides/webhooks
description_nb: Les Apiers endringsarkiv — created / updated / deleted-hendelser fra kildene Apier poller. Filtrer på source, entity_type, entity_id, change_type og from–to; markørbasert paginert nyeste-først (før `next_cursor` tilbake ordrett). Uten entity_id holdes personfelt-rader tilbake med hensikt (`personal_fields_withheld`). Krever read:changes. Ingen sandkasse-speil.

change_type.description: Filter to created / updated / deleted events.

cursor.description: Opaque signed cursor from a previous `next_cursor` — pass back verbatim.

entity_id.description: Filter to one entity's change stream (e.g. a 9-digit org number).

entity_type.description: Filter to one entity type (e.g. annual_accounts, company).

from.description: Lower bound on detected_at (ISO 8601 with timezone offset).

source.description: Filter to one upstream source (e.g. brreg / altinn / digdir / norges_bank). Omit for all sources.

to.description: Upper bound on detected_at; must be ≥ from.

name: list_changes

outputSchema.description: Rule 34 envelope; failures set result null + metadata.error_code / retryable / remediation. Contract: https://www.apier.no/docs/mcp

result.description: The change page: `data[]` rows (source, entity_type, entity_id, change_type, detected_at, source_snapshot_id, observation_kind), a `pagination` block, and `personal_fields_withheld`. Ordered newest-first.

title: Query the cross-source change archive
